cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Lose Something for Me
cards.instruction: Create a loyalty test by asking them to accept a real disadvantage on your behalf.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Miss the prize ceremony and come to my tiny opening night.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. I know. Coming wouldn't mean much if you had nothing else to do.
